'''2016 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Princeton, New Jersey, 11–15 August 2016. [[Tom Haid]] finished 1st in Day 3. Wrap labels Day 3 as Day 2 and Day 2 as Day 1; individual list titles use Day 3 for the Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Princeton, New Jersey
* '''Dates:''' 11–15 August 2016
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Haid]]
